price_series.2024_spread: Release real Bid/Ask at the executable minute

bar_construction.M5: five consecutive M1 UTC buckets; incomplete bar is unavailable
bar_construction.M15: fifteen consecutive M1 UTC buckets; incomplete bar is unavailable
bar_construction.M30: thirty consecutive M1 UTC buckets; incomplete bar is unavailable
bar_construction.execution: first available M1 executable open at or after information time

baseline_path_class.source: accepted executable M15-open path and accepted baseline final gross pips
baseline_path_class.WINNER: final gross pips greater than or equal to zero
baseline_path_class.P1: final gross pips negative and maximum executable M15-open mark at least 10 pips
baseline_path_class.P2: final gross pips negative and maximum executable M15-open mark greater than zero but below 10 pips
baseline_path_class.P3: final gross pips negative and maximum executable M15-open mark at most zero
baseline_path_class.floating_point_rule: no rounding or tolerance before class comparison

fold_population.2023: 960 closed accepted historical-compatible baseline tickets; one year-end right-censored ticket excluded from path evaluation
fold_population.2024H1: 428 accepted closed tickets; one half-year boundary-open B02 ticket excluded
fold_population.2024H2: 493 accepted closed tickets plus one F05 year-end ticket liquidated at final available executable quote and flagged boundary_liquidation

landmarks.L3_plus10: first M1 executable mark at or above +10 pips after entry; used only to arm observation
landmarks.L3_first_eligible_M30: first complete M30 bucket whose start is not earlier than the +10 landmark minute

session_labels_utc.HARD_EXCLUDED: 20:00 through 22:59 in US DST and 21:00 through 23:59 otherwise

exposure_labels.standalone: no earlier active baseline ticket at entry
exposure_labels.same_direction_stack: one or more earlier active tickets only in the same direction
exposure_labels.opposite_overlap: one or more earlier active tickets only in the opposite direction
exposure_labels.mixed_overlap: both same- and opposite-direction earlier active tickets
exposure_labels.simultaneous_rule: same-timestamp entries are labelled using stable baseline ticket order; earlier ticket at the timestamp is active for later ticket classification

candidate_counterfactual.entry_set: accepted baseline entry set remains invariant
candidate_counterfactual.baseline_exit_precedence: if baseline and candidate exits share an execution timestamp, baseline exit wins and effect is zero
candidate_counterfactual.missing_required_bar: candidate produces no trigger for that ticket
candidate_counterfactual.boundary_liquidation: reported separately and excluded from event-only gates
